changelog: Say "switch to English" — or "ইংরেজিতে বলো" in Bengali — alone while dictating in WhatsApp or Messenger and the keyboard switches its dictation language mid-message, without touching the language key and without losing anything you dictated. "Switch to Bangla" / "বাংলায় বলো" switches back, and just "switch language" / "ভাষা বদলাও" flips between the two. The key rows, language chip and space-bar label all follow the switch, and the choice is remembered for the next session. Saying the phrase inside a longer sentence still types it as normal text.
